approaching.ru: Источник звука частотой f₀ = {f0} Гц приближается со скоростью v_s = {vs} м/с. Скорость звука c = {c} м/с. Найдите наблюдаемую частоту.
approaching.en: A sound source at f₀ = {f0} Hz approaches at v_s = {vs} m/s. Sound speed c = {c} m/s. Find observed frequency.

receding.en: A sound source at f₀ = {f0} Hz recedes at v_s = {vs} m/s. Find observed frequency.

light_redshift.en: A galaxy recedes at v = {v} km/s. Find the redshift of a line at λ₀ = {lambda0} nm.
